subject.title: refactor(memory-wiki): move compiled cache to plugin state

question: Should `registerMemoryPromptPreparation` become a supported public plugin SDK lifecycle API now, with its ordering, failure behavior, and all prompt-caller coverage treated as compatibility commitments?
rationale: The change adds a documented, exported lifecycle contract beyond the Memory Wiki refactor; code review can identify missing callers but cannot choose the permanent external SDK guarantee.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle API after coverage repair
options.body: Keep the API, add the missing CLI preparation handoff and focused compatibility coverage, then document its lifecycle guarantees.

options.title: Keep preparation internal to Memory Wiki
options.body: Avoid a new public SDK contract by limiting the async state handoff to an existing internal owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle API after coverage repair
recommendation.body: Keep the API, add the missing CLI preparation handoff and focused compatibility coverage, then document its lifecycle guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch’s commit history shows direct authorship of the proposed API and its Memory Wiki consumer; final product authority remains with the protected-label reviewers.
